entries.name: acme.sh
entries.description: External ACME client. Gets and renews the certificate; a deploy hook uploads it with PUT /certificates/<name>. Any ACME CA.
entries.issuer: Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, any ACME CA

entries.name: acme.sh + НУЦ (Russian National CA)
entries.description: Stock acme.sh with an openssl CSR (C=RU + keyUsage) against the НУЦ ACME directory; deploy hook PUTs the bundle. No core change.

entries.name: acme.sh + Qaznet Trust Network
entries.description: Kazakhstan national root; the operator installs the root, browsers block it.

entries.name: acme.sh + Iranian national CA
entries.description: Iranian national root; valid only inside Iran, not in browser stores.
